claude.sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to knee osteoarthritis patient questions

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT knee OA responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: Readability scores significantly exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level (p < .001); simplification instructions improved readability only slightly, with no difference between detailed and simplified instructions.
links.quote: The readability scores for responses related to knee OA significantly exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level (p < .001).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses versus plain-language targets
links.effect: Readability scores significantly exceeded the sixth-grade level (p < .001); responses were often difficult to read and simplification prompts did not effectively simplify them.
links.quote: Although ChatGPT provides informative responses, they are often difficult to read and lack sufficient quality.

unlisted_practices: Prompting the LLM with detailed or simplified instructions to improve readability of responses
